about: T1206 (register rows T1140-b, T1138-c): synthetic booking documents with gold fields for the parse-booking eval. Every document, name, code and domain is made up (.example domains). Gold: bookings by kind, code, date, euro total (within 10 percent when converted from another currency), printed amount and currency, a printed link only, the trip city; activities by name and trip day. The default answers (answers.json) are hand-written reference answers, with one planted fault the shipped path must remove (an invented manage link on pb08); a live run records real answers with --answers.
